name: Sumitomo Warehouse Co Ltd/The
summary: Established in Osaka, Japan, in 1899, The Sumitomo Warehouse Co., Ltd. offers a full spectrum of logistics services domestically and internationally. These core operations encompass warehousing and merchandise preparation, alongside varied transportation solutions including consolidated small-lot freight, dedicated charters, and container shipping. Beyond physical goods, the company provides specialized storage and delivery for items such as documents, magnetic tapes, video recordings, and various fixtures, complemented by internet-based trunk room systems for inventory management. They also offer secure storage for safe deposit boxes, household belongings, valuable artworks, and high-value clothing and furs. Their maritime activities include harbor transportation, managing both container terminals and conventional vessel operations. As a ship agent, they handle husbanding, documentation, and a host of other related services, in addition to offering general marine transportation. The company is also significantly involved in real estate, undertaking the development, operation, and management of diverse properties like office buildings, residential complexes, commercial spaces, distribution facilities, business hotels, and rental galleries. This extends to providing real estate brokerage services. Further offerings include acting as an agent for indemnity insurance and air cargo. To enhance its service delivery, Sumitomo Warehouse leverages advanced information systems such as SWIFT, an integrated distribution system, and SWAN, for logistics management.
